name: king
description: KING — jogo de cartas multiplayer (web + app). Monorepo. Família Verbete.

scripts.dev:server: npm run build:server && npm start --workspace apps/server
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace packages/engine && npm run build --workspace apps/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/engine && npm run test --workspace apps/server && npm run test --workspace apps/web && npm run test:progresso-sql:ci
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/engine && npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.ci: npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke:server && npm run test:e2e
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm --workspace apps/web exec cap sync && npm run mobile:preparar && npm run mobile:validar
